text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant 3.Highschool's degree diploma Highschool certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of highschool schoolUIBE Application Form (Required to fill out online) 5.A copy of TOEFL 90 above or IELTS 6.0 above 6.Two reference letters from the applicant's professors 7.A copy of master thesis or other published thesis required for Doctoral Programs 8.UIBE Application Form (Required to fill out online)
